description.fun: A little dung beetle that rolls a ball of mud instead, made by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures that mud ball more than its own life and rolls it around while the energy it needs to evolve slowly matures. The mud ball may nod to dorodango, the Japanese art of polishing mud into shiny spheres, and its name is 'roller' spelled backwards.
description.guide: A Bug-type dung beetle Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that rolls a ball of psychic mud. It evolves into Rabsca after walking 1,000 steps with its Trainer outside its Poké Ball.
description.tagline: A dung beetle that treasures its psychic mud ball

description.fun: A scarab that floats upside down, gently rolling a glowing ball over its body so the infant sleeping inside stays comfortable. The body holding the ball barely moves, so some think Rabsca's true body is the infant in the ball. It may draw on Khepri, the scarab-faced Egyptian god of the rising sun, and its name is an anagram of 'scarab'.
description.guide: The evolution of Rellor, a Bug and Psychic-type scarab Pokémon that floats upside down holding a ball with an infant sleeping inside. It may be inspired by the Egyptian god Khepri.
description.tagline: A floating scarab rocking a baby in a ball

transitions.how: Level up, after walking 1000 steps with it

note.text: Like Pawmo and Bramblin, Rellor evolves only after walking 1,000 steps with its Trainer using the Let's Go! feature, outside its Poké Ball, then levelling up.
